title: 7 Best Recruitment Software for HR Teams (2026)
summary: Compare the 7 best recruitment software of 2026, including brioHR, OmniHR, and Workday HCM. See ATS features, pricing, and hiring automation tools.
body_markdown:
## How to Choose the Right Recruitment Platform


The right choice depends less on a feature checklist and more on how recruitment connects to everything that happens after someone accepts an offer. Here's what to weigh.


### ATS Depth vs. Broader HR Coverage


A dedicated ATS like Manatal or Zoho Recruit gives you deeper recruiting-specific features (AI scoring, sourcing tools) but leaves you managing onboarding, payroll, and performance in a separate system. A connected HRMS trades some of that recruiting-specific depth for a single system of record from application through payslip.


brioHR's[applicant tracking system](https://briohr.com/products/recruitment-ats/) sits inside the same platform as[onboarding](https://briohr.com/products/products/onboarding/) and payroll, so a hire doesn't need to be re-entered into a second system on day one.


Explore the[best healthcare HR software](https://briohr.com/blog/hr-software-for-healthcare/) for broader workforce management.


### Local Compliance vs. Global Feature Breadth


Platforms built for the US or global enterprise market (BambooHR, Workday HCM) often carry more general feature depth, but Malaysia and Singapore statutory requirements like EPF, SOCSO, CPF, and SDL either need a partner tool or only get partial support. Regional platforms handle this natively from the moment a candidate is hired. If local payroll compliance is a priority, compare[Bamboohr alternatives](https://briohr.com/blog/bamboohr-alternatives/) for Malaysia and Singapore before choosing a platform.


brioHR handles EPF, SOCSO, EIS, CPF, and SDL natively, so new hires move into[payroll](https://briohr.com/products/payroll/) and[leave management](https://briohr.com/products/products/leave-and-time-off/) without a second vendor.


### Pricing Model and Hidden Add-Ons


Per-employee pricing looks simple until add-ons like applicant tracking modules, implementation fees, or monthly minimums show up separately from the base rate. Ask any vendor for the fully loaded cost of the features you'll actually use, not just the entry-tier number on their pricing page.


brioHR's modular pricing starts at RM3 per employee per month, with recruitment included as part of the connected platform rather than a separate line item.


## How We Selected These Recruitment Tools


We evaluated each platform against three criteria: genuine applicant tracking depth, pricing transparency, and fit for Malaysia and Singapore compliance requirements. Tools that lack a real ATS, such as several local payroll-first platforms, were excluded even though they appear in other brioHR comparisons.


### Genuine ATS Functionality


We prioritized platforms with native job posting, resume parsing, interview scheduling, and pipeline tracking, not tools where recruitment is a single checkbox feature bolted onto payroll software.


### Pricing Transparency


We checked whether each platform published clear rates or required a custom quote, and flagged add-ons (like BambooHR's separate ATS module) that change the real cost of hiring-focused use.


### Regional Fit for MY and SG Teams


We weighted platforms with native EPF, SOCSO, CPF, and SDL support higher, since a recruitment tool that can't carry a new hire into compliant payroll creates extra work rather than removing it. Education institutions can apply the same regional-compliance criteria when comparing[HR software for education](https://briohr.com/blog/hr-software-for-education/) .
